problem:
Consider the following initial value problem:

$$
{y}^{′}=2x-y+3,\,y(0)=\frac{1}{3}
$$

We wish to approximate the solution using the Runge-Kutta (RK4) method. What entry should be placed in the cell indicated in the table below, if the step size is $Δx=1?$

| $\,x\,$ | $\,y\,$ | $\,{y}^{′}\,$ | $\,{y}_{1}^{′}\,$ | $\,{y}_{2}^{′}\,$ | $\,{y}_{3}^{′}\,$ | $Δy$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $\frac{1}{3}$ |  |  |  |  |  |
| $1$ | $\,?\,$ |  |  |  |  |  |
